nodes.name: appsurfaces.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the App Surfaces screen, showing a catalogue of connectors, MCP servers, and marketplace items with rail navigation and grouped list rows using the Waggle Hive design system.

nodes.name: auth.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the authentication screens (Sign in / Sign up), featuring a split-panel layout with a brand pitch side and a form side, with Google/GitHub social login and optional Clerk integration.

nodes.name: benchmark.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Benchmark screen, displaying model evaluation results, capability charts, and SOTA comparison data using the Waggle Hive design system.

nodes.name: billing.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Billing screen, showing tier comparison cards (FREE/PRO/TEAMS/ENTERPRISE), subscription management, and Stripe-backed payment flows.

nodes.name: chat.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Chat / agent conversation screen, featuring a message thread with artifact cards, tool-use indicators, persona switching, and the primary interaction surface of Waggle OS.

nodes.name: evolution.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Evolution screen, illustrating the self-improvement subsystem UI with version ladders, optimization runs, and evaluation results.

nodes.name: habit.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Habit / daily loop screen, showing streak tracking, recurring task prompts, and engagement mechanics for the Waggle OS habit-loop feature.

nodes.name: home.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Home / Cockpit screen, the primary landing surface featuring overnight briefing story, quick-capture, workspace shortcuts, and task summaries using the Waggle Hive design system tokens.

nodes.name: ia.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Information Architecture (IA) overview screen, documenting the 5-zone calm spine navigation structure (Work/Intelligence/Extend/Team/System) and the IA freeze decisions.

nodes.name: launcher.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Launcher / AI-OS dock screen, showing the multi-tool detection panel, installed AI tool status, and launch-with-prompt surface.

nodes.name: marketplace.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Marketplace screen, displaying skills/connectors/MCP servers in a grid shelf layout with one-click install, tier gating badges, and search/filter controls.

nodes.name: memory-trust.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Memory Trust front-door screen, showing provenance pills (user_stated / tool_verified / agent_inferred), memory frame management, confirmation flows, and trust-level indicators.

nodes.name: onboarding.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the 5-step Onboarding wizard screen, including workspace creation, persona selection, model key validation, and the hard-gate flow before granting access to the main app.

nodes.name: platform.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Platform screen, presenting system capabilities, runtime info, model routing status, and infrastructure details for the Waggle OS platform view.

nodes.name: settings.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Settings screen, covering model key management, BYO-key validation, tier display, advanced options, and show/hide gating for sensitive configuration sections.

nodes.name: storage.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Storage screen, showing memory/files storage breakdown, source attribution, data-where-it-lives visualization, and import/export controls.

nodes.name: surfaces.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Surfaces overview screen, cataloguing all interactive app surfaces and their layout zones within the Waggle OS UI shell.

nodes.name: workspace.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the Workspace Desktop screen, the per-workspace task board and agent interaction surface with real task CRUD, artifact cards, and deep-links to agent centers.

nodes.name: workspaces.html
nodes.summary: Design handoff mockup for the All Workspaces grid screen, showing workspace cards with status badges, last-active info, and shelf layout for switching between projects and areas.
